experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Took over a startup's early-stage mobile app and backend, both built with no dedicated engineer and little structure, and rebuilt both from the ground up.

Replaced a WebView wrapping a static web dashboard with a fully native Flutter app — provider-driven state management, live GPS map tracking, analytics charts, and a custom point-to-route deviation detection engine built from vector math.

Rebuilt the Node.js/Express backend, replacing hardcoded, unstructured logic with a clean REST API split across MongoDB and MySQL. Used MongoDB for sensor telemetry since sensors don't always send every field — a fixed SQL schema would create many empty (null) values, wasting space and slowing queries — and kept MySQL for structured business data.
Added a WebSocket layer (Socket.io) end-to-end — backend broadcasts live updates, Flutter dashboards consume them in real time, removing the need for manual refreshes.
Implemented JWT authentication, request validation, and rate limiting across the API.
Chose which parts of the old system needed fixing right away and which could wait, based on the founder's priorities for stability.

projects.name: LoreKeeper API — Personal Reading Tracker Backend
highlights: Built a Spring Boot REST API for a personal reading tracker covering books, manga, and comics, following a clean 4-layer architecture (Entity -> DTO -> Repository -> Controller).
Implemented stateless JWT authentication with Email/Password login as well as Google OAuth sign-in.
Integrated the Open Library API to auto-fetch book metadata, page counts, and cover art.
Used PostgreSQL for persistence, with Jakarta Validation and a centralized global exception handler for strict data integrity.
Added Runeglass, a rule-based adaptive reading-assistance highlighter module built into the API.

projects.name: Lorebound — Offline EPUB Reader (Flutter)
highlights: Building an offline-first EPUB reader in Flutter with a custom, fully native render engine (no WebViews) for direct control over performance and typography.
Implemented dual reading modes — paginated and infinite vertical scroll — with an immersive, distraction-free overlay UI.
Designed local library management (importing EPUBs, tracking reading progress) as a standalone offline app, built to later serve as the mobile front-end for the LoreKeeper API.
